result.title: Continuous Noisy-Loop Models
result.summary: Efficient learning and inference need not imply a compact probabilistic circuit. We quantify this distinction for continuous noisy readings of agreement between adjacent latent spins on a known square grid with $d$ edges. With known margins and bounded Lipschitz channels, minimax squared Hellinger risk is $Θ(\min\{1,dN^{-2/3}\})$ from $N$ independent vectors, without a reliability lower bound. A spline estimator reaches this rate in polynomial arithmetic time given a fixed positive reliability bound; an exponential-size mixture removes that requirement. At fixed positive reliability, nonnegative decomposable circuits need $\exp(Θ(\sqrt d))$ nodes for fixed total-variation error below one, even when each leaf uses at most $αd$ coordinates, $0<α<1$. Optimal Kullback--Leibler (KL) approximation error is $Θ(d/\max\{\log d,\sqrt\ell\})$ in either direction with at most $d^r$ nodes and leaf scopes $\ell\leqαd$, for fixed $r>1$ and $0<α<2/3$. Node counts exclude leaf computation. For three fixed masks, optimal joint conditional KL has order $d/\log d$ when $\ell\leq(\log d)^2$. Local cycle identities relate joint divergence to identifiable channel products and separate weak-channel recovery from density estimation. Factorized evidence preserves a planar zero-field Ising model: given local integrals, exact queries cost $O(d^{3/2})$ arithmetic operations and one root extraction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在已知方格上的连续噪声环模型（相邻 latent spin 一致性）中，量化“学习与推断高效”与“存在紧凑概率电路”之间的分离，给出 minimax Hellinger 风险速率、knot/spline 估计器、非负可分解电路所需节点数的 exp(Θ(√d)) 下界，以及 KL 近似误差与叶子作用域的权衡和因子化证据下的精确查询复杂度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文关于表示容量、叶子作用域与所需节点数的复杂度结论，可能为「latent 状态在何种条件下必须压缩或丢失视觉证据」以及信息坍缩的评价提供形式化视角，可供核查；但材料仅涉及统计理论与概率电路，无视觉/多模态推理实验，与 LVR 的联系属推测。
